gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-94.274211 29.929639)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-94.274211 29.929639)',4326)::geography,
        2200
      )
  AND tourism = 'zoo';

distance_result AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Distance(zoo1.geom, zoo2.geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM zoo1, zoo2
),
clip_area AS (
  SELECT

  FROM zoo2

elevation_result AS (

  FROM clip_area, public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, clip_area.search_area)
)
SELECT 
  distance_result.distance_meters,
  elevation_result.elevation_meters
FROM distance_result, elevation_result;
